en.askTitle: Swap in your own devices, commute and budget to get a shortlist built the same careful way
en.runTitle: US commuter with glasses: noise-cancelling headphones under $350 for calls, flights and an iPhone plus Windows laptop

fields.label: Budget and whether it includes tax and shipping
Phone, laptop and call apps
fields.value: An iPhone and a Windows laptop

fields.label: Commute, flights, calls, glasses, wear time and music
fields.value: A 90-minute subway commute every day, a few flights a year, a lot of calls (mic quality and multipoint pairing matter), wears glasses, needs comfort for 3+ hours; over-ear and earbuds both considered

en.template: Find noise-cancelling headphones in {country} by {date}, within {budget}, for ZIP {zip}. My devices and apps are {devices}; my commute, flights, calls, glasses, wear time, ear fit and music needs are {details}. Separate sellers, exact versions and new/refurbished/open-box condition. Check dated cash prices, delivery and opened-product returns; cart buttons are not stock confirmation. Separate independent tests, maker claims, owner posts and your judgment, and state test settings only when available. Verify multipoint and USB audio/mic support. If scoring, show components, weights and method; keep fit and stock as deciding checks. Give a conditional shortlist, unavailable information and a return-window test plan. Do not buy, add to carts, contact anyone or claim hands-on testing.

phases.title: Check current prices, lab reviews and owner reports for each model
phases.note: Maker and retailer pages, lab test pages and owner forums
phases.judgment: Two tempting deals were checked and set aside: a $149.95 JBL lead turned out to be an open-box unit, and the $199.99 Sony WH-1000XM5 was out of stock for delivery, available only for pickup at one store. Neither is presented as a nationwide deal.

phases.title: Build the sourced comparison page and the scored workbook, with an independent audit
phases.note: Scores come with their weights and method
phases.judgment: An independent reviewer judged the shortlist defensible, and also sent back fixes: a label said six scoring dimensions when there were seven, and two owner-post details whose forum threads could not be re-opened needed a direct link or softer wording.

phases.title: Check the files, then deliver the shortlist and buy-now advice
phases.judgment: On buy now or wait it gave a split answer, not one blanket call: Bose’s $219 price (a sale running to 8 November) is worth taking now if comfort comes first, while for Sony and Soundcore it suggests waiting for better prices.

workers: Opened the maker and retailer pages for each model and recorded the price, stock and delivery as read on 5 November
Found the independent lab reviews for ten models and noted their noise-cancelling, battery and microphone results
Collected dated owner posts on comfort with glasses, reliability, app updates and multipoint pairing
Independently audited the sources and the scoring logic before delivery

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的设备、通勤和预算，就能得到同样认真核对的候选清单
zh.runTitle: 戴眼镜的美国通勤族：350 美元以内的降噪耳机，要能打电话、坐飞机，还要配 iPhone 和 Windows 笔记本

fields.label: 购买截止日
fields.placeholder: 例如：2026 年 11 月 20 日前

fields.label: 手机、电脑和通话应用
fields.value: 一部 iPhone 和一台 Windows 笔记本

fields.label: 通勤、飞行、通话、眼镜、连续佩戴和音乐偏好
fields.value: 每天坐地铁通勤 90 分钟，一年坐几次飞机，电话很多（麦克风质量和多点连接很重要），戴眼镜，要连续戴 3 小时以上也舒服；头戴式和入耳式都考虑

zh.template: 请帮我在{country}、{date}前挑降噪耳机，预算{budget}，邮编{zip}。设备和应用是{devices}；通勤、飞行、通话、眼镜、连续佩戴、耳部贴合和音乐偏好为{details}。分开比较卖家、确切版本及全新、翻新、开箱成色。核对带日期的现金价格、配送和拆封后退货规则，不把购物车按钮当有货确认。区分独立测试、厂商标称、用户反馈和你的判断，只在查到时写明测试条件。核实多点连接及 USB 音频和麦克风支持。如评分，列出分项、权重和方法；仍以贴合度和库存作决定。给出有条件的候选、查不到的信息及退货期试用计划。不要购买、加入购物车、联系任何人或声称亲测。

phases.title: 核对每款耳机当前的价格、实验室评测和用户反馈
phases.note: 厂商和零售商页面、实验室测试页、用户论坛
phases.judgment: 有两个诱人的优惠被查验后搁置：一条 149.95 美元的 JBL 线索其实是开箱二手品；199.99 美元的索尼 WH-1000XM5 无法配送，只能在一家门店自取。两个都没有当作全美通行的优惠写进去。

phases.title: 做带来源的对比页和评分工作簿，并请独立同事审查
phases.judgment: 独立复核同事认为候选清单站得住，同时退回了修改：有处标签写“六个评分维度”而实际是七个；另有两处用户帖细节，原论坛帖子打不开重核，需要补上直接链接或改成更谨慎的措辞。

phases.title: 检查文件，交付候选清单和买不买的建议
phases.judgment: “现在买还是等”它没有一刀切：Bose 的 219 美元价格（促销到 11 月 8 日）如果优先看舒适度，值得现在入手；索尼和 Soundcore 则建议等更好的价格。

workers: 打开每款耳机的厂商和零售商页面，记下 11 月 5 日读到的价格、库存和配送
找到十款耳机的独立实验室评测，整理降噪、续航和麦克风测试结果
收集带日期的用户帖子：戴眼镜舒不舒服、可靠性、应用更新和多点连接
交付前独立审查资料来源和评分逻辑
